checkpoints.description: Task 'art-early-mobs-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: clamp the enemy walk step so all walk-row frames stay on canvas, switch the renderer from the idle workaround to the real walk row, regenerate every enemy sheet, and verify a moving room

impact_assessment.why: Every enemy walk row has blank odd frames because _enemy_common returns a full plus-or-minus one step as the body's horizontal offset, which throws the body off-canvas; the renderer works around it by replaying idle frames, so moving enemies only bob.
impact_assessment.benefits: All 41 walk rows become valid and the renderer uses them, adding a side-to-side body sway to the existing vertical bob so every moving enemy reads as walking rather than sliding.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sheets.loadEnemy now reads the walk row; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; art: every enemy PNG regenerates, frame sizes and atlas keys stay the same.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Clamp the walk step to a small amplitude, inspect idle/walk/attack/death rows, chase a live room at two moments, and rerun tests, build and all eight gates.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Phase 4 green: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics and all 8 gates pass; all 41 walk rows now have four populated frames and the renderer reads them; a controlled live room with all six new early mobs chasing produced a capture with zero console errors. checklists: passed
Task 'art-enemy-walk-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: make inventory rows click-to-equip with live stats and safe discard, switch choice cards to one-click or 1/2/3 with right-click ignored and a short arming delay, move HP/mana/XP to a bottom-center HUD panel, and enrich the level-up sound

impact_assessment.why: The inventory only reacts through small action buttons with no stat feedback, choice cards need a second confirmation and do not filter non-left input, HP and XP sit in the top-left corner away from the action, and the level-up cue is a short arpeggio.
impact_assessment.benefits: A click anywhere on a bag row equips it, live stats show the effect, discard needs a deliberate second click, choice cards take one left click or 1/2/3 with a short arming delay, the bottom center carries HP/mana/XP, and level-up gets a layered fanfare.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: inventoryScreen signature and choice input behaviour; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: UI state only, no save or simulation changes; UX: single-click cards can be misclicked, so the screen arms after a short delay and ignores right-click.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Playwright sequences for row click, button click, discard confirm, right-click and number-key choice, 1/2/3 and left-click selection, bottom HUD at 1440x900 and 1024x640, plus tests, build and all eight gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implement: inventory rows click-to-equip with live stats and armed discard, choice cards single-click with arming grace and RMB ignored, HUD vitals moved to bottom center, level-up fanfare
[3/3] Verify: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics, 8/8 gates; Playwright inventory/choice/HUD flows with zero console errors; checklists: passed
Task 'fix-inventory-choice-hud-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: give the six wisp-kind enemies distinct silhouettes (echo orb+crystal, spirit ghost+antlers, shadow hooded, prism faceted gem, voidWalker tear, solderWisp ember) in _wisp, regenerating their sheets

impact_assessment.why: echo, spirit, shadow, prismEntity, voidWalker and solderWisp all share one wisp body with palette swaps, so the mid and late roster repeats one silhouette.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each wisp-kind enemy reads as a distinct creature at play scale without changing atlas keys or frame sizes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: _wisp signature and atlas keys unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: generated PNGs only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Regenerate all sheets, run the asset test, capture a live room with all six wisps, 8/8 gates.
